title: Apply v3 — job pain opener, real 'how' (pre-selling), comment question
music: Santigold - Disparate Youth (TikTok sound, starts at 'Don't look ahead'): bar = 1.5785 s

sections.text: Time off, denied. Closing Saturday. Thirteen twenty-five an hour.
So you design a hoodie on your break, and your friends call it unrealistic.
Then they apply to companies that started as somebody else's idea.
Your first store flops. So does your second.
Third time, you post the hoodie before it even exists. Forty people ask where to buy it. Thirty-eight pay before you print a single one.
Now the people who laughed are in your replies, asking how you started.
So what would you sell first?
